decision.title: Phase 7 gate review (packet )
decision.summary: The Phase 7 gate review finds every packet's gate met but 7.11's fn:transform cases, with XP40 and XQ40 at 99.5 %, XT40 at 94.8 % and no suite lower than at Phase 5.

body.p: by the review agent (), after , , , and the Phase 7 records to . The four suites were run whole in release (tools/run-qt4.sh XP40 and XQ40, run-xslt.sh, run-xsd.sh; every test set finished, 0 error outcomes) at 6f79d8d and again at 9c5b1ba after the review's code changes, with the same numbers; docs/CONFORMANCE.md is regenerated from the second run. The gate boxes and a table of every Phase 7 packet against its gate are in docs/tasks/phase-7.md. Fuzzing beyond two minutes a target and the full lint of every preset are left to the owner's machine ().

item.p: Numbers (release, 9c5b1ba): XP40 32,689 passed, gate rate 99.5 % (gate 90 %); XQ40 45,969, 99.5 % (85 %); XT40 12,075, 94.8 % (70 %), the 12 core sets 88.5 % (mode) to 100 % (80 % each); XSD in scope 41,486 of 41,518, 99.9 % (90 %), datatypes 100 % (95 %), structures 99.7 % (80 %), XSD 1.1 99.7 % (70 %); schema-aware XQ40 1,397 of 1,516, 92.2 % (70 %), XT40 928 of 971, 95.6 % (60 %). None lower than at the Phase 5 gate (). Slices 198/198, XSLT 149/154, XSD 147/147. xmlconf: XML 1.0 valid 601, invalid 175, not-wf 948, external entities 127 / 54 / 66, XML 1.1 84 / 13 / 169, all pass, DTD validation of the invalid cases 173 + 54. html5lib 1,749 of 1,753 / 7,045 / 82. Sizes: sxml.wasm 2,090,746 / 730,902, sxml-full.wasm 7,637,162 / 1,690,683, the CLI module 9,231,791 / 1,973,839, all under 's budgets; the guard reports +1,978 bytes over its baseline (ir_verify, ir, ir_global_read: 4.21's GLOBAL_READ), a lean core. A streamed sum over 1,000,000 orders (74.7 MB) peaks at 11.0 MB resident (7.6's 64 MB). Benchmarks: xmark-all 1.10 s, itunes 2.29 s.

Per-packet gates: met by every packet but two. 7.11's "all 12 XT40 transform cases" is not met (9 pass; transform-004, a static fn:transform, transform-401, a ~record pattern; transform-009 not run, an assertion the driver does not check). 7.4's "all 5 QT4 cases" is met as reads it: the 4 that fail expect fn:number conversion of xs:numeric parameters, which XPath 4.0, 3.4.1 gives only to xs:double. 7.3 (evaluate 77 of 83, 92.8 %) and 7.13 (xmlconf 1.1 271 of 271) now meet the gates they had not met when they were done.

Fuzzing (the fuzz preset's smoke runs, then two minutes each of html_parse_fuzz, ixml_fuzz, dtd_fuzz, full_text_fuzz and xml_parse_fuzz): src/xml_input.c (7.6f) added an offset to the null bytes pointer of an empty input, undefined (C17 6.5.6p8), so four targets stopped on their first input; no other finding.

The iXML suite's 4 error outcomes: inputs with C0 controls, which no xs:string holds (XML 1.0, 2.2), so fn:invisible-xml cannot be given them. The driver reads the file's bytes and reports the case not run with that reason (: the cause is outside the processor, and a decoding fault of sxml still shows as an error). Suite 886 of 907, 0 errors, 21 not run.

docs/C_GUIDELINES.md on a sample of the new files (html, ixml, full_text, cldr, collation, timezone, dtd, evaluator_stream, xml_input, the EXPath libraries, xquery_update): no abbreviated or single-letter names; three functions of src/function_library_file.c had four parameters (now request structs) and the file had four clang-tidy findings (two analyzer null dereferences behind require_file_system, a short loop variable), now clean.
Conceptual smallness: Full Text's sxml_full_text_bytes and its two append functions were a copy of sxml_xml_buffer; Full Text uses the buffer.

Record numbers: every D-number is unique (, to and are unused, left by renumbering). Code citing (HTML, now ) and for 7.6c's lowering override, mode query and streamed attribute paths (now ) is corrected; every other citation names an existing record of the matching packet.

Added: the fuzz targets ixml_fuzz (a grammar text and an input through fn:invisible-xml) and full_text_fuzz (a selection over a text and stop word list through XQuery), with seeds from the iXML suite, the QT4 ft- sets and html5lib (html_parse_fuzz had none); tools/fuzz.sh runs the dtd, html, ixml and full-text targets by default. The XQuery run and the heap leak check are shared in the fuzz fixture.

: tools/check-call-cycles.py finds no cycle (229 files, empty allowlist). Through function pointers: features are reached only through their operations tables and call neither each other nor their caller; the Earley parser charges steps through a meter that only counts; the RBNF interpreter (src/spell_out.c) and the Snowball interpreter (src/full_text_stem.c) keep their substitutions and routine returns on explicit stacks; the parse tree, the HTML working tree and update application are walked by links or explicit stacks; STREAM and MERGE are resumable tasks of the evaluator, the parser's events are queued (NOTIFY) or copied into window builders (tees, CAPTURE) and never evaluate; fn:transform and xsl:evaluate ask the machine for a unit evaluation, no nested run.

: each still-delayed feature has one place: staticTyping (the drivers' non-goal), XInclude (FODC0013 in src/function_library_json.c), DTD validation without its feature (FODC0013 in src/processor.c), schema location hints and remote HTTP (the resolver serves nothing), xsl-stylesheet-processing-instruction and HTML4 output (the XSLT driver's non-goals), merge sources with validation, type, accumulators or predicates (grounded, ), XSLT's own Full Text (grammars/xpath, XPST0003), the CLI's Windows file system (no platform file). The places the Phase 7 packets replaced are gone (XTDE0160, XTDE3175, XUST0026, the absent functions); the supports-* properties name the features.
/: the core links no feature definition; the guard's growth is the IR's. XQuery, XSLT and the features stay out of sxml.wasm.

Larger duplicates, listed ('s list stands): three UTF-8 and UTF-16 decoders with different error rules (src/xml_encoding.c fails, src/text_decoding.c for fn:unparsed-text and the EXPath libraries fails with its own newline rule, src/html_encoding.c replaces, as WHATWG asks); Full Text's stop word and thesaurus reading calls the resolver itself (src/full_text_resource.c, for the document-node form) beside sxml_optional_feature_read_data and the document loader; private growable arrays in src/collation_tailoring.c, src/function_library_element_map.c, src/cldr.c and src/collation_uca.c beside sxml_xml_array. The interpreters are not duplicates: Earley (iXML), RBNF (CLDR spell-out), Snowball (stemming), the regex engine and the full-text match program each run the notation their specification defines; there is one CLDR reader (src/cldr.c) and one feature data loader.

Proposed, resolved here: XQuery's XML version () and the Phase 7 scope and size items were decided by , and (a processor option for the version of query text, defaulting to 1.0, is the design; the header field waits for a packet); the three CLI and core WebAssembly budget items (2.18, 3.12, 4.15, 5.10) are superseded by , and (budgets follow features, the core stays lean); XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default () takes the proposed default by , as a design for a later XQuery sweep: the library's XQuery default becomes no (K2-Serialization-22, -23 and Serialization-xml-01 expect a declaration), with the header's comment, while sxml xquery keeps writing none unless the query asks. They leave Proposed; the owner's three items stay.
Not done (listed in the LOG): 7.11's three XT40 transform cases; 7.4's four QT4 cases (by ); the larger duplicates above; Phase 7 fuzzing at length and the full lint on the owner's machine.
